This looks like a generic single-page boilerplate (theme toggle, nav, placeholder content). Before I dive in — what's the actual purpose of this page (e.g., personal site, product landing, docs)? That determines whether "improve" means real content, SEO/meta fixes, or added features.

If you just want a quick pass without more context, I'd fix these concrete issues:
- Placeholder content/meta (title, description, og:image, email, canonical URL) never got filled in with real values.
- Small robustness gap: theme toggle icon (🌙/☀️) is set via emoji text instead of an SVG, so it won't match your favicon style and can render inconsistently across platforms.
- No `lang` alternates / no actual navigation targets beyond the single page's own sections (fine if intentional single-page site).

Let me know the real content/purpose and I'll make targeted edits.
